equity_bridge.note: Investments 51,361 less 21,001 HTM time deposits already in cash = 30,360 book at 2026-06-30 (Q2-2026 results balance sheet). Their income (equity in affiliates, dividends, fair-value changes) is outside adjusted EBITDA, so the matching-asset rule puts the asset in the bridge. 20% haircut for disposal tax leakage (FY2025 MMYT sale bore ~14% tax) and unlisted-stake discount. The H World stake backs the US$500m exchangeable notes, which are in total_debt.

equity_bridge.note: RMB5,180m charged to Q2-2026 G&A (results announcement 2026-09-15); other current liabilities +4,251 QoQ. Includes RMB1,658m disgorgement and RMB122m hotel-deposit refunds.

equity_bridge.note: 1,615 + 140 at 2026-06-30 (Q2-2026 balance sheet); flows are consolidated so the NCI stock is deducted once here.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2026 guidance-anchored (H1 +11%, Q2 guide +3-8% realised +6%, H2 ~+4%); cross-checked against the FY2019->FY2025 pre-COVID revenue CAGR of 9.8% and equity 5y CAGR 11.2%, both above the selected rate
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: 3y and 5y CAGRs are computed off COVID-depressed bases (FY2020 revenue 18.3bn vs 35.7bn FY2019) and are not usable: revenue 3y 46% vs equity 3y 15% diverges >30%. EPS and FCF CAGRs are null because FY2020-22 owner FCF and FY2020-21 EPS were negative. Owner FCF grew faster than reported FCF since FY2019 (21.5% vs 13.0%) because SBC (1,714 -> 2,270) and interest income (2,094 -> 2,603) grew slower than FCF; SBC is not eating the growth here, unlike the US SaaS pattern.
historical_growth.notes: FY2025 net income 33,386 includes a RMB19.9bn one-off investment gain (RMB15.2bn MakeMyTrip sale); FY2025 reported FCF carries the RMB2,073m tax on it. Neither is a base. Series computed from 9961.HK_Metrics.csv (FreeCashFlow, StockBasedComp, InterestIncome), which is identical to TCOM_Metrics.csv.

scenario_narratives.base: The SAMR remedy (no exclusivity, no lowest-price clauses, refunded deposits) is a one-time reset of domestic take-rate and growth rather than a structural collapse: domestic accommodation and ticketing grow low-single-digit from FY2026, while the Trip.com international platform (+50% YoY) and inbound travel (high double-digit) keep the group at 7-8% through FY2029 before decelerating to 3%. Adjusted EBITDA margin sits at 29% for two years and drifts to 31% as international scales, never regaining the FY2024 32% peak. SBC is charged at 4% of revenue declining to 3%. The RMB74bn net cash and the ~RMB24bn investment portfolio are added at the bridge; the RMB5.2bn fine is deducted. No further antitrust action, and the VIE structure holds.
scenario_narratives.bull: Beijing's anti-involution campaign bites rivals as hard as Trip.com, the remedy normalises the whole OTA market instead of singling out the leader, and domestic growth recovers to high-single-digit. International sustains 40%+ growth and reaches margin breakeven, inbound compounds toward the 200m-traveller target, outbound holds above 140% of 2019. Group growth 11-12% in FY2027-28, adjusted EBITDA margin to 33.5%, terminal growth 3%. The US$5bn buyback at a 5x EV/EBITDA entry point adds to per-share value but is value-neutral in the model.
scenario_narratives.bear: The remedy is not one-and-done: regulators keep pressing dominant platforms, the loss of exclusivity compresses accommodation take-rate, Meituan's bundling triggers a price war, and consumer travel spend stalls on energy prices and the property-sector overhang. Group growth 2-3% from FY2027, adjusted EBITDA margin falls to 24% (the FY2023 level) and stays there, SBC % drifts up. International decelerates to 20-25% against Booking/Agoda. Net cash and investments still floor the value well above zero -- this bear is a stagnant cash box, not a solvency case. The VIE/HFCAA binary tail (contract invalidation, forced Nasdaq delisting -- the HK line mitigates liquidity, not VIE risk) is not modelled as a cash flow; it is the reason the bear weight is 30%, not 15%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Trip.com is valued as an operating cash-flow stream in RMB on a strict owner-FCF basis (SBC expensed, interest income stripped, share count flat), discounted at a CNY-built 10% WACC, with the RMB74bn broad net cash, the investment portfolio at 80% of book, the accrued SAMR fine and NCI bridged to equity, then translated to HKD per share at the live CNY->HKD rate. The three scenarios are the axes the Analysis JSON identifies: durability of the domestic take-rate after the antitrust remedy, the pace of the international/inbound build-out, and whether platform regulation recurs. Risk is charged once -- in the flows and the 30% bear weight -- not stacked into the discount rate. Terminal value is capped at 15x owner FCF because travel is discretionary and the regulatory regime is restrictive. The 9961.HK and TCOM builds share one RMB model; they differ only by the quote currency.
key_risks_to_valuation: Recurring PRC platform antitrust action or a sector-wide price war compressing accommodation take-rate below the bear path
VIE contractual-structure invalidation or HFCAA-driven Nasdaq delisting (the HK listing mitigates liquidity, not VIE risk) -- a binary tail outside the cash-flow model
RMB depreciation versus the USD-pegged HKD: every 5% move in CNY/HKD moves the HKD per-share value ~5% with no change in the RMB business
The investment portfolio (RMB30bn book) is added at 80% of book; listed stakes could trade below carrying value and unlisted stakes could be impaired
H1-2026 owner FCF (~RMB4-5bn) is counted in both the June-30 net cash and the FY2026 Y1 flow (~HK$8/share overstatement, partly offset by full-period discounting of a 3/4-earned year)
Travel demand shock (pandemic, geopolitics, energy) -- FY2020 showed owner FCF can swing to -RMB8bn in a year

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (HKEX regular close); 52-week range 294.6-613.0; Nasdaq TCOM ADR parity check in inputs.fx_note
data_sources.financials: research/9961.HK/Reports/9961.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, CNY millions, FY2019-FY2025, parsed from the HKEX annual reports in Extracted/); 2026-06-30 balance sheet, SAMR accrual and diluted share count from the Q2/H1-2026 results announcement (6-K 2026-09-15, as used by the TCOM build); FY2025 cash flow statement and adjusted-EBITDA reconciliation from 9961.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt
data_sources.qualitative: research/9961.HK/Reports/9961.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-24): SAMR fine, Q2-2026 guidance, competitive and regulatory risk set, bull/bear axes; driver judgments carried from research/TCOM/Reports/TCOM_Drivers.json (2026-10-04)

inputs.share_count_basis: Q2-2026 non-GAAP diluted weighted-average count (659,356,092; Trip.com 6-K 2026-09-15 reconciliation table), the latest treasury-stock-method diluted figure. One HKEX ordinary share = one Nasdaq ADS, so the count is identical for both listings. Basic shares were 629.7m at 2026-03-31 (20-F / HKEX annual report FY2025) and 632.3m weighted in Q2-2026 after ~RMB10bn+ of H1-2026 buybacks under the US$5bn Aug-2025 programme. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so charging dilution as well would double-count. The US$1.5bn 0.75% 2029 convertible (22.7m shares at ~US$66 conversion) is carried as debt, not shares; it is far out of the money and puttable June 2027.
inputs.cash_definition: Company's own broad definition at 2026-06-30: cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash 56,016 + short-term investments 23,499 + held-to-maturity time deposits and financial products (inside long-term Investments) 21,001 = RMB100,516m (Q2-2026 results announcement: 'RMB100.5 billion'). Debt = short-term debt and current portion 25,767 + long-term debt 630 = 26,397 (includes US$500m 1.50% 2027 exchangeable notes and US$1.5bn 0.75% 2029 convertible). Operating-lease liabilities (567 non-current + current portion) EXCLUDED: leases are charged inside adjusted EBITDA (treatment B).
inputs.sbc_source: 9961.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt consolidated cash flow statement 'Share-based compensation' RMB2,270m (Metrics.csv StockBasedComp; ties to the adjusted-EBITDA reconciliation add-back). No separate equity-award tax-withholding line exists (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 every year): awards are options settled by exercise (proceeds RMB493m in financing), so the combined figure equals the add-back.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing-activity outflow 'Cash paid for repurchasing of ordinary shares' RMB4,396m (Metrics.csv ShareRepurchases; FY2023 1,617, FY2024 2,172). Pace stepped up sharply in H1-2026 under the US$5bn Aug-2025 authorization: basic weighted shares fell 655.9m (Q4-25) -> 649.0m (Q1-26) -> 632.3m (Q2-26), implying ~RMB10bn+ repurchased in H1-2026. Flat count is being FUNDED by repurchases; buybacks are value-neutral in this model.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); ordinary shares quoted in HKD on the HKEX (secondary listing; 1 HK share = 1 Nasdaq ADS). fx_rate is the engine's reporting->quote multiplier: 1 CNY = HK$1.1755, i.e. HKDCNY 0.8507 (Yahoo HKDCNY=X, 2026-10-23T21:10Z). Triangulation: USDCNY 6.6606 / USDHKD 7.8413 = 0.8494 CNY per HKD (Yahoo CNY=X and HKD=X, 2026-10-23T21:00Z), 0.15% from the direct cross. Parity check via the Nasdaq ADR: TCOM US$39.78 (2026-10-23T20:00Z regular close) x USDHKD 7.8413 = HK$311.9 against the HK$314.8 HKEX close the same day (closed ~12 hours earlier), a 0.9% tie that confirms direction and quote basis. The HKD is pegged to USD, so RMB/HKD moves are RMB/USD moves. Per-share values in CNY are emitted as the *_cny twins; the sibling TCOM build (research/TCOM/Reports/TCOM_Drivers.json, 2026-10-04, fx 0.14915 CNY->USD) carries the same CNY per-share values. Note scripts/sanity_check.py uses the reciprocal convention (quote->reporting, 0.8507) for its historical table -- see memory note sanity-check-fx-rate-direction-conflict.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-23T08:08:08Z HKEX regular close (Thursday 16:08 HKT); 52-week range 294.6-613.0, price sits in the bottom tenth of the range
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency: 10y CGB risk-free ~1.8% + beta 1.2 x (mature-market ERP 5.0% + China country risk premium ~1.8%) = ~10.0% cost of equity; ~95% equity weight, ~2% after-tax cost of debt -> WACC ~9.6%, rounded up to 10.0%. The country premium is the only China charge in the rate; VIE/antitrust/HFCAA risk is charged ONCE, in the flows, via the 30% bear weight and the bear driver path -- no per-scenario WACC differences. House US-tech default is 10.5% against a 4.2% rf; a 10.0% CNY rate against a 1.8% rf is a wider risk spread. Identical to the TCOM build: the discount rate belongs to the flows, not the listing venue.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) Leases as operating cost. US GAAP ASC 842 operating-lease expense (RMB250m ROU amortisation + lease interest) sits inside operating expenses and the company's adjusted EBITDA does NOT add it back (its D&A add-back of 845 = 647 PP&E depreciation + 198 intangibles/land-use amortisation, excluding ROU; Metrics kpis Depreciation/Amortisation). Lease liabilities (RMB849m at 2025-12-31, 9961.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:13223) therefore excluded from net debt; da_pct_path is ex-ROU. Charged exactly once.
inputs.nci_treatment: Consolidated flows (NCI share of profit is RMB92m FY2025, ~0.3% of net income, immaterial to the margin path); NCI RMB1,615m + mezzanine redeemable NCI RMB140m at 2026-06-30 deducted ONCE in the equity bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row 1-2: consumer-internet marketplace, non-US filer with reporting currency != quote currency -> owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md parts a, b, c, d). First valuation of the 9961.HK line (no MEMORY entry, no prior DCF), but NOT a first valuation of the company: the Nasdaq ADR TCOM was built on 2026-10-04 (research/TCOM/Reports/TCOM_Drivers.json) on the same RMB statements and the same 2026-06-30 balance sheet. The two listings are fungible (1 share = 1 ADS) and no filing has landed since (Q3-2026 results due mid-November 2026), so every driver path, anchor, bridge item, weight and narrative is carried over from TCOM DELIBERATELY UNCHANGED; only the quote layer differs (HKD price, CNY->HKD fx, HKEX price timestamp). Diverging the two builds would make the same company worth two different amounts in RMB. What would move the drivers: Q3-2026 results (H2 growth and margin vs the ~+4% / 29% assumed), any further SAMR or train-ticketing action, the FY2026 cash tax outturn, and the 2026-12-31 balance sheet. OWNER FCF FY2025: reported FCF 13,582 (OCF 14,379 - capex 797) - SBC 2,270 - interest income 2,603 = 8,709. Interest income stripped because net cash RMB74bn is ~8x the FCF base. FY2025 reported FCF is itself depressed by the RMB2,073m capital-gains tax paid on the MakeMyTrip share sale (one-off, in OCF via cash taxes 5,740 vs 2,700 FY2024) and a RMB-5.7bn working-capital outflow (prepayments/other current assets); the component build does not carry that forward. FY0/Y1 TIMING: FY0 = FY2025 actuals (calendar year), Y1 = FY2026, the guidance year; balance sheet is 2026-06-30, so H1-2026 owner FCF (~RMB4-5bn, ~HK$8/share) is both in net cash and in the Y1 flow -- partly offset by discounting a 3/4-earned year a full period. Known, stated, not adjusted. FY2026 BASE: H1-2026 revenue 31,871 (+11.2% YoY), Q2 +6% within the 3-8% guide; H2 modelled at ~+4% (SAMR contra-revenue, exclusivity unwind, energy-price headwind on ticketing) -> FY2026E ~66,950, +7%. SAMR: RMB5,180m penalty accrued in Q2-2026 G&A; other current liabilities rose 4.25bn QoQ, so it is treated as accrued-unpaid at 2026-06-30 and deducted in the equity bridge. If any portion was already paid by June 30 the deduction is slightly double -- conservative. GROWTH-DIVERGENCE: historical CAGRs from FY2020-22 bases are COVID artefacts (3y revenue CAGR 46%); the pre-COVID FY2019->FY2025 6y CAGR of 9.8% is the meaningful history and the selected 7% is below it. TERMINAL CAP 15x (not 20x): discretionary travel, China platform regulation. SBC is projected as % of revenue (4.0% anchored to H1-2026's 4.2%, declining to 3.0%). Street basis adds back SBC; band_position reported.

bear.growth_rationale: Y1 +5% (H1 already banked at +11%, H2 flat); FY2027-28 +2% as the end of exclusivity and lowest-price clauses compresses accommodation take-rate and Meituan's super-app bundling takes share in a price war; macro (energy, property-sector consumer) caps domestic; international decelerates to 20-25% against Booking/Agoda.
bear.margin_rationale: Take-rate compression and sustained S&M at 28-29% push adj. EBITDA margin to 24%, the FY2023 level, and it stays there; SBC % drifts up as revenue stalls.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 FY2026 +7%: H1 actual +11.2%, H2 ~+4% as the SAMR contra-revenue and exclusivity unwind bite and ticketing (-1% in Q2) stays soft. FY2027-29 7-8%: domestic low-single-digit post-remedy, international platform (+50% in Q2-2026, est. low-teens % of revenue) and inbound (high double-digit) contribute ~5-6pp of group growth; decelerates to 3% by Y10 as international matures.
base.margin_rationale: Adj. EBITDA margin 30.3% FY2025, 32% FY2024, 29.5% H1-2026, 29% Q2-2026 with S&M at 25% of revenue amid the competitive/compliance reset. Base holds 29% for two years then drifts to 31% as the loss-making international platform scales; never regains the FY2024 32% peak.
base.tax_rationale: PRC statutory 25%, key subsidiaries at 15% high-tech rate, plus 5-10% withholding on cash repatriated for buybacks. FY2024 GAAP tax / operating income = 18%; FY2025 cash tax ex the RMB2,073m one-off = 3,667 on 15,773 operating income = 23%. SBC is not tax-deductible so the engine's post-SBC EBIT base understates taxable income: 21% on post-SBC EBIT ~ 18% pre-SBC. Flat 21%.
base.wc_rationale: Advances from customers (20.9bn) and payables (20.0bn) roughly match receivables (17.1bn) plus prepayments (25.9bn); FY2024 captured +38% of revenue growth, FY2025 -63% (prepayments/loans-to-users build). Mixed sign -> small 5% capture.

bull.growth_rationale: Domestic recovers to high-single-digit once the remedy is absorbed and the anti-involution campaign hits Meituan/Fliggy equally; international platform sustains 40%+ and inbound compounds toward the 200m-traveller ambition; outbound keeps running >140% of 2019.
bull.margin_rationale: Margin recovers past the FY2024 32% peak to 33.5% as international reaches scale and AI cuts service cost; S&M intensity normalises to ~22%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: single-regulator dependency (SAMR has just fined the company RMB5.2bn and ordered a change to the core hotel-contract model), a VIE-structured China company with a binary legal tail, and management's own linkage of the growth collapse (+17% to +6% in one quarter) to compliance adjustments. Bull cut from 35% to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right -- domestic recovery, international reaching scale against Booking/Agoda, and no further regulatory action. Base 50%. Same weights as the TCOM build: the listing venue does not change the probabilities.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
